c.v: For processors designed based on a pipeline, it is ideal that CPU issues one instruction onto the pipeline per processor cycle.
The ESP32-S3 Xtensa processor adopts the 5-stage pipeline technology: I (instruction fetch), R (decode), E (execute), M (memory access), and W (write back).
